title: GF unveils roadmap to deliver the world’s most advanced FD-SOI platform for Physical AI
key_facts: GlobalFoundries (GF) unveiled plans on 9 Oct 2026 for FDX Fusion, an FD-SOI platform built for Physical AI.
Manufacturing is planned to start in 2028 at GF's Dresden, Germany facility.
The first generation is expected to deliver seven-nanometre-class digital performance and more than 2x density over first-generation FDX.
It targets edge inference, robotics, industrial automation, autonomous systems and sensor fusion.
Demonstrator silicon is targeted for early customer evaluation in early 2027, with an initial process design kit (PDK) in mid-2027.
GF says it is engaged with several customers on early development and evaluation.
Dresden expansion is supported under the framework of the European Chips Act.
quote_evidence: The company plans to commence manufacturing FDX Fusion technology in 2028 at its advanced facility in Dresden, Germany, reinforcing the site's role as a strategic European hub for differentiated semiconductor technologies.
Demonstrator silicon for FDX Fusion technology is targeted for early customer evaluation in early 2027, with an initial process design kit (PDK) release planned for mid-2027.

GF is engaged with several customers on early development and evaluation for FDX Fusion, using real application requirements to inform product design and accelerate the technology's progress from platform definition to production readiness.
why_it_matters_hint: A European-made low-power chip platform for robots, cars and factory machines, planned for 2028.
